segments.ja259:1.1: Nayimassa vijjāmayamatthi kiñci, na bandhavo no pana te sahāyo;
segments.ja259:1.3: Atha kena vaṇṇena tirīṭavaccho [tirīṭivaccho (syā. ka.)], tedaṇḍiko bhuñjati aggapiṇḍaṃ.
segments.ja259:2.1: Āpāsu [āvāsu (ka.)] me yuddhaparājitassa, ekassa katvā vivanasmi ghore;
segments.ja259:3.1: Etassa kiccena idhānupatto, vesāyino visayā jīvaloke;
segments.ja259:3.3: Lābhāraho tāta tirīṭavaccho, dethassa bhogaṃ yajathañca [yajatañca (sī. pī.), yajitañca (syā.)] yaññanti.
